story.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT Search Is About 20% of Google’s, 250 Million People Speak With ChatGPT, and Chat Is Merging With Work - Big Technology | Alex Kantrowitz

facts.text: Ahrefs, using mid-2025 data, put ChatGPT at about 12 percent of Google's search volume for things people traditionally searched for.OpenAI Sued By Parents Of Amazon Engineer With Epilepsy Who Died After Alleged ChatGPT Medication AdviceFrom coding help to everyday lookupsFry said ChatGPT's early use was mostly writing and coding help, tasks people don't typically search for.
OpenAI says ChatGPT now handles roughly one search-like query for every five that Google handles.
Search Engine Journal says the ratio is hard to compare with other estimates until OpenAI clarifies which Google figure it used.Outside estimates have been lower, though older.

They also moved into finance and health questions, where ChatGPT runs a web search to keep answers current.In his words, it covers anything people once took to a traditional search engine that they now take to ChatGPT.Growth in contextOpenAI said ChatGPT passed 1 billion weekly users in August and cited 1.2 billion by late September.

The claim comes from OpenAI itself, and the company has not said how the comparison was made.Adam Fry, OpenAI's ChatGPT consumer product lead, gave the figures to Alex Kantrowitz of Big Technology at an OpenAI-hosted dinner in New York.

Fry summed it up this way, "The growth is just going big."Abu Dhabi Signs Four OpenAI Deals, Starts Pilot Toward An 'AI-Native' Government: All DetailsHow OpenAI counts a 'search'The comparison hinges on definitions.
The same reports note that OpenAI did not give the source of the Google figure, the time period or the geographic scope.
The company added 200 million users over just the past two months, jumping from 1 billion to 1.2 billion weekly active users in 60 days.
Its search volume, it says, is approximately 20% of Google’s.
Its users create 1.5 billion images with it per week.
Bing’s share of the search market is around 5%.
Does that make you multiple times larger than Bing?
Adam Fry: ChatGPT has been growing quite quickly.
ChatGPT’s volume of search-like queries is now roughly one-fifth the volume of queries of Google.

During our conversation, Fry also revealed plans to merge ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes (so that confusing toggle up top will soon go away), agreed with feedback that ChatGPT-created restaurant signage looks too uniform, and addressed the cost to serve its personal assistant Dots.
ChatGPT consumer product lead Adam Fry told me this during a brief fireside chat at an OpenAI-hosted dinner in New York City on Monday night.
The growth is just going big, and we’re staying very focused on how fast ChatGPT is growing.
I might have 20 prompts back and forth in a ChatGPT conversation.
Adam Fry: What people came to ChatGPT for to start, if you go back about two years, is really writing help and coding help.
Those wouldn’t be things that you really search for.
It’s a pretty amazing statistic when you think about it, mainly because we started just about a year and a half ago.
It’s hard to remember this, but ChatGPT at a time didn’t have any up-to-date information.
You’d ask a question, it would say something like, “It’s past my training date,” and nobody had any idea what that meant.
